task: E2 CC/PH readout on the four official test splits

protocol.normalisation: x standardised by inner-train mean/std; y by inner-train mean/std
protocol.optimiser: AdamW + cosine annealing anchored to the candidate budget
protocol.selection: minimum inner-dev MSE over the candidate budget; median selected epoch across probe seeds
protocol.final_refit: refit on all rows of the full official-train set at the selected epoch; evaluated once per test split
